searchText: The RPL bond could be slashed as a penalty, but if the operator goes with the minimum 10% (1.6 ETH worth) it's not a large enough disincentive long term. The oracle node accounting is a better solution probably After the merge, client teams could offer a voluntary flag that changes the coinbase for 1-2 attestations to their own address, to make development sustainable. That's what mining software currently does. i personally would use it 🙂 Why not just donate money to client teams directly? Is the issue that it isn't obvious where to send such money to? Or perhaps it is the psychological effect of having to say, "no, I don't want to contribute" vs simply not going out of your way to contribute? Or perhaps the idea is that it would be on by default, but something you could turn off so that by default people will donate? convenience, this model has worked well for PoW so why not adopt a working business model 😄 > Or perhaps the idea is that it would be on by default, but something you could turn off so that by default people will donate? That's up for the client devs <dankrad> or just take a 5-10% cut <dankrad> that would make it sustainable
